reizmelt.name: Reizmelt

canon_ref.note: A small northern Izril town (~5,000 people) where Ryoka works as a Street Runner under the name Ryoka (6.00, 6.01).

reizmelt.summary: A modest northern Human town of stone and timber where Ryoka settles after leaving Liscor, taking small delivery runs for the local Runner's Guild.

huntress_haven.name: The Huntress' Haven

canon_ref.note: Madain's inn in Reizmelt where Ryoka and Alber rent rooms and Fierre eats breakfast (6.00, 6.01).

huntress_haven.summary: A lively Reizmelt inn owned by Mad Madain, who wakes his guests at dawn with a banging pan and serves fresh game he hunts himself.

blaisefords_lookout.name: Blaiseford's Lookout

canon_ref.note: A small hill town twelve miles from Reizmelt where Ryoka delivers a letter to Lord Beilkit of House Malt (6.00).

blaisefords_lookout.summary: A small hill town twelve miles from Reizmelt where minor nobles like Lord Beilkit of House Malt keep their sheep-country estates.

gilliel_swamplands.name: Gilliel Swamplands

canon_ref.note: Marshlands near Reizmelt infested with Wailer Frogs where Ryoka helps rescue the Pithfire Hounds (6.00).

gilliel_swamplands.summary: A treacherous stretch of marshland near Reizmelt, loud with Wailer Frogs and dangerous enough to trap Silver-rank adventurers.

drakle_estate.name: Drakle Keep

canon_ref.note: The ruined keep and sheep farm of House Lischelle-Drakle in the northern hills where Fierre's Vampire family lives (6.00, 6.01).

drakle_estate.summary: A half-ruined stone keep and sheep farm in the hills outside Reizmelt, home to Fierre and the surviving Vampires of House Lischelle-Drakle.

baepr.name: Baepr

canon_ref.note: A village roughly sixteen miles from Reizmelt mentioned as one of Ryoka's delivery stops (6.01).

baepr.summary: A small northern village sixteen miles from Reizmelt on Ryoka's delivery circuit.

lellisdam.name: Lellisdam

canon_ref.note: A northern settlement with an alchemist's guild that corresponds with Kelysta in Reizmelt (6.01).

lellisdam.summary: A northern Izril town whose alchemists trade letters and orders with Kelysta's shop in Reizmelt.

ambault.name: Ambault

canon_ref.note: A nearby northern city or town mentioned by Fierre (6.01) and by Celum's alchemists as a match supplier (6.02).

ambault.summary: A northern Izril town within trading reach of Reizmelt and Celum, known for its alchemists and match makers.

orefell.name: Orefell

canon_ref.note: A mining town mentioned by Zevara when inspecting Numbtongue's gold-bearing ore (6.03).

orefell.summary: An Izril mining town whose rich gold veins Zevara compares to the ore Numbtongue brings back from the Floodplains hills.

goblin_graves_hill.name: Hill of the Redfang Graves

canon_ref.note: The hill near the Wandering Inn where Numbtongue buries Headscratcher, Shorthilt, Bristler, Badarrow, and Pyrite under five stone cairns (6.03, 6.08).

goblin_graves_hill.summary: A quiet hill overlooking the Floodplains where Numbtongue builds five stone cairns for Pyrite and his fallen Redfang brothers.

numbtongue_mana_cave.name: Numbtongue's Mana Stone Cave

canon_ref.note: A hidden cave in the foothills of the High Passes where Numbtongue mines red, blue, green, white, and black mana stones with Pyrite's memory (6.07D).

numbtongue_mana_cave.summary: A secret cavern in the High Passes foothills lined with multi-colored mana stones, discovered by Numbtongue with Pyrite's mining instincts.

drake_village_hut.name: Lawes's Village Hut

canon_ref.note: A rented hut in a small farming village three miles from Pallass where Salazsar's spy Lawes hides Ilvriss's black mana stone door (6.11).

drake_village_hut.summary: An ordinary hut in a farming village three miles outside Pallass, used by the Salazsar spy Lawes to house Ilvriss's secret teleportation door.

rissa_scribe_shop.name: Rissa Inkscale's Scribe Shop

canon_ref.note: Rissa Inkscale's cramped, ink-stained shop in Liscor where Ilvriss and Osthia commission portraits of Az'kerash's Chosen (6.11).

rissa_scribe_shop.summary: A cluttered Liscor workshop smelling of ink and parchment, where Rissa Inkscale draws lifelike portraits for paying clients.

tails_and_scales.name: Tails and Scales

canon_ref.note: A popular tavern on Pallass's second floor run by the Gnoll [Bartender] Rufelt and his Drake [Chef] wife Lasica (6.09, 6.10).

tails_and_scales.summary: A warm, bustling second-floor tavern in Pallass run by the married Gnoll-and-Drake pair Rufelt and Lasica, welcoming Drakes and Gnolls alike.

talenqual.name: Talenqual

canon_ref.note: A major featherfolk-ruled city on Baleros with a Dullahan quarter, where Geneva, Daly, Luan, and Kenjiro establish the United Nations company (6.04D - 6.06D).

talenqual.summary: A major Balerosian city with a busy Dullahan district, where Daly's Bushrangers and Geneva's clinic join forces to found the United Nations company.

cinfal.name: Cinfal

canon_ref.note: A distant Balerosian port or town where three French Earthers live under the Iron Vanguard's protection (6.05D).

cinfal.summary: A Balerosian city in Iron Vanguard territory where several Earthers live under the great company's protection.

ger.name: Ger

canon_ref.note: Capital city of Germina and site of the ancient stone circle where the Quarass is reborn in a child (6.12K).

ger.summary: The ancient capital of Germina, built around the sacred stone circle where the nation's rulers gather to witness the Quarass's rebirth.

blalevault.name: Blalevault

canon_ref.note: Capital of Hellios, taken by Flos Reimarch when Queen Calliope abdicates to spare her son Siyal (6.12K).

blalevault.summary: The royal capital of Hellios, where Flos Reimarch breaks the kingdom's last defense and receives Queen Calliope's abdication.

jecrass.name: Jecrass

canon_ref.note: Mentioned in 6.14K; seen in 6.15K as King Raelt's kingdom bordering Reim and Belchan, divided between crown and River Wardens.

jecrass.summary: A Chandrarian kingdom south of Reim ruled by King Raelt, whose fertile riverlands are contested by greedy River Warden nobles.

belchan.name: Belchan

canon_ref.note: A southern Chandrarian nation bordering Jecrass that raids Jecrass's villages while Reim marches north (6.14K, 6.15K).

belchan.summary: A Chandrarian nation neighboring Jecrass whose border forces opportunistically raid Jecrass's riverlands during Flos's wars.

pomle.name: Pomle

canon_ref.note: Mentioned in 6.14K; seen in 6.15K as a neutral oasis sanctuary of martial artists in the Zeikhal Desert led by Orjin the Strongest.

pomle.summary: A neutral oasis nation in the Zeikhal Desert home to thousands of martial artists under Orjin the Strongest, where nine rulers meet in summit.

tiqr.name: Tiqr

canon_ref.note: Mentioned in 6.14K; represented at Pomle in 6.15K by its ruler Empress Nsiia, the [Empress of Beasts], before nine nations declare war on it.

tiqr.summary: A lush Chandrarian realm ruled by Empress Nsiia, the [Empress of Beasts], famed for its tamed wildlife and targeted by a nine-nation coalition at Pomle.
